log_level.description: Log verbosity level; acceptable values are 'error', 'warning', 'info', 'debug'

listen_addresses.description: List of transport addresses the broker listens on

auth_mechanisms.description: Authentication mechanisms the broker supports; values like 'EXTERNAL', 'DBUS_COOKIE_SHA1', 'ANONYMOUS'

service_activation.description: Service to auto-start on bus initialization (e.g., system-wide service). Optional.

name.description: Well-known D-Bus name of the service to activate

exec.description: Absolute path to the executable to launch

user_rules.description: Per-user connection limits and privileges. At least one user rule should be present.

introspection_enabled.description: Whether to allow introspection via org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable. Disable for production security hardening.

audit_level.description: Audit logging level: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled (logs security-relevant events)

inactivity_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) before closing inactive connections

max_outstanding_messages.description: Maximum number of queued messages per connection

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a single message (e.g., 100 MB)

max_fds_per_connection.description: Maximum number of file descriptors that may be passed per connection

max_fds.description: Maximum number of file descriptors the broker process may open system-wide

listen_backlog.description: Maximum number of pending connections in the kernel listen queue
